== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Councilors]] serve as the leadership for the [[Consultant's Guild]] and act as the primary representatives of the [[Am’haranai]]. Comprised of three members, they are also referred to as the [[Architects]] of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]. They view themselves as the foundational designers and protectors of the civilization, describing their role as gardeners who shepherd humanity through darkness to ensure prosperity. While many [[Architects]] remain unseen or unknown, the three High [[Councilors]] are distinguished by their practice of meeting openly around a white, waist-high column. One recognized member is [[Yala the High Mason]]. The [[Council]] functions with significant [[Authority{{!}}authority]], making strategic decisions regarding the stability of the throne and the management of global networks. They coordinate with specialized [[Architects]], such as [[Readers]] and historians, to analyze threats to [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]. Following the death of the Emperor, the [[Council]] has shifted its focus toward addressing the instability caused by the potential rise of the [[Regents]] and the ongoing threat posed by the [[Great Elders]].}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Councilors]] are a group mentioned by [[Shera]] that includes three members representing the [[Consultant's Guild{{!}}Consultant’s Guild]]. During his deliberations, [[Lucan]] suspected that these councilors might be driven by selfish motivations. In preparation for upcoming events, [[Lucan]] drafted letters intended specifically for them. Ultimately, three of these High [[Councilors]] were present at the front of [[Shera]]'s meeting.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Three High [[Councilors]] represent the [[Consultant's Guild{{!}}Consultant’s Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] considered that the High [[Councilors]] might have had selfish motivations.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] prepared letters for the High [[Councilors]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
